text.es: Ay, dios mío, Marta. No sabes cómo te mereces todo esto, de verdad. Has luchado muchísimo para llegar hasta aquí. Has tenido que derribar muros que tus hermanos por el hecho de ser hombres ni se imaginan.
text.en: Oh my God, Marta. You have no idea how much you deserve all this, truly. You've fought so hard to get here. You've had to tear down walls that your brothers, simply because they're men, can't even imagine.
